sourceTitle: The physiology of digestion considered with relation to the principles of dietetics
description: "The Physiology of Digestion Considered with Relation to the Principles of Dietetics" by Andrew Combe is a scientific publication written in the mid-19th century. The work thoroughly explores the physiological processes involved in digestion and correlates them with dietary practices, aiming to inform readers about the mechanisms of the human digestive system and how to maintain optimum health through proper nutrition.
